newsitem.title: SPAIN: BT, MCI say in strong position in alliance.
newsitem.headline: BT, MCI say in strong position in alliance.

text.p: The chairmen of British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Communications Corp, which just formed a strategic partnership with Telefonica de Espana SA, said on Friday the alliance would put them in a very strong position in the industry.

"The alliance of BT, MCI and Telefonica will bring us in an extremely strong position in the future with the liberalisation of the telecoms sector in Europe in the beginning of 1999," BT chairman Iain Vallance told a news conference in Madrid.
MCI chairman Bert C Roberts told the same conference that the alliance was like a telecoms "dream team".
"Joining the alliance with Telefonica we will create a telecoms dream team," he said. "We will create the premium telecoms alliance for the next millennium."
